title: Inbox task and complete customer-delivery installation

task.name: Operate the customer’s original retained request as a complete, independently receivable task delivery
task.purpose: Give the named customer or reporting application every selected original response, its saved task/read identities, native outcome and complete maintained source; reopen and continue that same work after interruption.
task.request: Select the original initialized Inbox, Node buyer state, task revision and its native task SHA. Retain the exact original receiving destination or verified delivered packet, optional commerce session and saved RPC read edition. Preview the useful customer task using the original intended requests and complete selected source; obtain the original review before an explicitly authorized execute or recovery. Prepare a stable named customer delivery from the complete verified packet and preserve the full returned request and preview SHA. Packaging, downloads, installation and customer receiving reuse the same original output.
task.completeOutput: Complete selected source/runtime/profile/lock and private installation input packet; original task and operation records; every complete selected response with exact byte/hash and outcome/read observations; full customer package and manifest; independent original recipient receiving/history and offline reopen; editable native Installation and whole-case handover.
task.repeatTrigger: An actual customer-selected next reporting period, source edition or changed useful request, reviewed in the original caller task/version and budget. Repeated download, recovery or receiving of an already paid result is continuation of that original task.
task.pricedUnit: The merchant’s explicitly selected useful request or agreed complete reporting task. Preserve its approved atomic price and bounded task count separately from software installation and receiving.

source.reference: Select the actual original task/packet, Inbox and any commerce read edition from the accountable case.
source.population: Complete original selected request records, all response bytes, task plan and manifest, prior attempt and recovery outcomes, selected source manifest and all application files. The live source/service and each retained edition keep their original separate identities.
source.meaning: Keep intent IDs, caller system/id/revision, task and preview hashes, native request/response status, observation times, settlement binding and original response types/units as supplied. A recovered saved read remains distinct from its earlier uncertain attempt. Whole customer output must include every selected original file.
source.changePolicy: A new source period or changed task creates its original reviewed next revision. Preserve prior versions, named package requests and independent receiving histories. Changed source or request bytes cannot silently reuse an accepted original delivery ID; read-only reconciliation compares the complete request and preview.

receiving.application: Maintained buyer-task-desk selected runtime, existing Inbox tasks Applications entry, Merchant Task Desk provider/typed CLI, and original Collections customer-delivery receiver.
receiving.acceptanceRule: The actual named receiving engineer opens the complete original output and source on its selected host, verifies every complete member and the original task/request/package identities, reopens the saved result after closure, and demonstrates retained-request continuation without a second purchase. Record actual returned native outcomes and remaining limits in the existing Installation; a preparation, source review or merge is not observed acceptance.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The original buyer controls future execution and spending. Stop/reconcile the actual managed application before changing runtime or roots; preserve customer packages and histories. Source rights, provider credentials and revocation remain under their original operator and commercial terms.
receiving.recovery: Retain original absolute operating roots, native task SHA, receiving destination, selected runtime/profile/lock, application/command request IDs, complete customer preview request and package digests. A moved complete packet opens for review/download without starting a new receive. Lost replies reconcile the original command or named delivery; full transfers retain exact selected bytes.
receiving.maintenance: One accountable installed-application owner operates the original Applications or foreground lifecycle. The existing native-course owner retains an in-flight customer receiving operation. Hand over complete source, operating guide, dependency archive, original state backup and exact customer package; software updates and new customer tasks remain separate reviewed work.

steps.title: Receive the original commercial and operating case
steps.result: Use the original Workshare source and complete packet, existing funded plan and installation seed. Preserve actual phases, effort, responsibilities, pricing and independent buyer identity; bind the useful customer task and permitted source period.

steps.title: Build and receive the complete selected runtime
steps.result: Build selection buyer-task-desk from the full reviewed commit. Receive its complete archive, original dependency profile/lock and runtime transfer through the maintained installer. Record READY runtime identity and original runtime-workspace record, with no change to existing buyer roots.

steps.title: Select and inspect the original task and locations
steps.result: Prepare the private installation selection with the exact existing Inbox/state/task/output/commerce and separate customer store. The native Applications provider verifies the task SHA, complete packet or original receiving intent, source/runtime binding and resource roots. Retain the complete prepared packet.

steps.title: Review and start one original application
steps.result: Use original Applications configuration review/save/start and retained UUIDs, or the explicit foreground original CLI owner. Verify the live instance/root announcement and retain it for Merchant. Preserve native lifecycle ownership; do not duplicate an active or uncertain owner.

steps.title: Open and review the actual customer task
steps.result: Open the original saved task or preview/save a useful next revision from existing jobs. Retain its original intents, exact selected saved RPC read and review. Explicit execution/recovery remains with the buyer under the existing authority and budget.

steps.title: Receive the complete original task output
steps.result: Resume only the retained original receiving destination. Verify every complete output, native task/plan/manifest and both original attempt and recovered result observations. An intact moved packet stays available as delivered output without starting another receiving.

steps.title: Review and prepare the named customer package
steps.result: Create the full executing-source census, retain the full preview request/SHA and select a stable named delivery. Prepare using the original customer model. Reconcile the exact same request after an interrupted reply; preserve conflicting requests and their histories.

steps.title: Transfer and independently receive the whole product
steps.result: Stream the complete package through the browser or typed Merchant CLI, retaining package/member manifests, byte lengths and digests. The independent customer uses the original receiver to reopen every response, source file and readable review in its own private workspace.

steps.title: Close and reopen the same work
steps.result: Close actual listeners, reopen the sender task and named delivery, then reopen recipient history and the unchanged whole package. Record the actual original native receiving return and customer use; no new provider request is needed for these continuations.

steps.title: Return the native Installation and complete editable handover
steps.result: Record real work/purchase/outcome references against the original checks and phases. Export the complete original case with every attachment, reopen its same Installation in the independent receiving case, and retain maintenance/recovery ownership for the next actual task.

inputs: Original customer Workshare/commissioning JSON, complete matching packet, pinned plan/seed and actual case version.
Actual independent buyer and merchant deployments, named receiving engineer/host, original source-use authority and agreed useful task.
Complete READY selected runtime path/ID, source commit/archive/manifest, dependency profile/lock and original executable.

Exact original SF88 runtime, Node buyer state, initialized Inbox, saved task revision/task SHA, receiving destination or complete delivered packet, optional operator workspace and RPC commerce session.
Separate private customer-delivery store, installation connection directory and enough receiving space for all original files.
Original selected request/intent/read identities, native review and explicit task authority; approved asset/network/recipient, atomic unit price, task count and whole-task budget.
Complete executing application source census and manifest, retained customer preview request/hash and stable named delivery ID.
Original output/response/package/archive byte counts and SHA identities, complete original recipient runtime and source, and its independent private receiving destination.
Actual returned native operation and customer acceptance records, original saved uncertainty/recovery observations, complete state backup and support owner.
